facts.fact: Starlink has no official authorisation in Cameroon; its licence application has sat unresolved for over two years, and the regulator ART declined comment, saying the file is with the ministry MINPOSTEL (NewsWatch, 27 July 2026).

In 2024 the government banned Starlink and a Customs circular of 15 April 2024 ordered seizure of Starlink terminal kits at the borders as escaping ART oversight; the article says the circular remains operative.
